correctness.rationale: All-N proof: the nonincreasing clipped affine interval map has monotone iterates and hence zero topological entropy by an O(n/epsilon) separated-set bound. Every nonfixed orbit is eventually captured by the 0↔3/5 two-cycle. For all N≥10, exact cell integration gives only three possible targets from cell zero, and the targets are in the constant branch. Every cell has a positive transition path to zero, so the closed class is unique and its stationary weights are exact. The row Shannon formula yields three residue-dependent constants. Rational checks on N=10..200 only corroborate the universal proof.

value.rationale: Exact stationary Markov entropy on shrinking grids is a motivated quantitative invariant used to characterize dynamics. This all-resolution law proves persistent artificial entropy bounded below by log(2)/2, three arithmetic entropy phases, unique stationary Markov classes, and weak convergence to the period-two physical measure of a zero-topological-entropy map. It sharply separates chain resampling entropy from deterministic dynamical entropy, a substantive boundary to interpreting coarse-grid entropy diagnostics.
